result: the town-map Fly problem is solved
what_changed: Flying stopped being driven by a hand-derived cursor sequence and started being judged by the map underfoot. _fly_to_town tries an offset, confirms, asks the game where it landed, and moves on if that is not the destination.

evidence_it_worked.before: two runs ended at 'Fly to Vermilion failed', arriving at Viridian
evidence_it_worked.after: no fly failure at all; the run flew to Vermilion, entered the Center, healed at the nurse, and failed two steps later on the walk east to Route 11
evidence_it_worked.reading: The failure moving forward is the result. Nothing about the town map's layout was ever learned, and nothing needed to be.

the_defect_this_run_also_fixed.cause: The first version of the search kept pressing A until the map changed. An attempt that flew nowhere therefore left eight unanswered presses in the field, and the next attempt opened onto a prompt where only A and B were watched -- so the d-pad did nothing and the cursor could not move. The search was poisoning its own next attempt.
the_defect_this_run_also_fixed.fix: Confirm once, allow one further press for a waiting prompt, then wait and look. An attempt that changes nothing closes back to the field first.
the_defect_this_run_also_fixed.lesson: A retry loop that presses buttons to make progress has to consider what those presses mean when there is no progress to make.

why_this_generalises: Recognising success by the game's own state rather than by a belief about a screen is now the second time this has resolved something that resisted careful guessing -- the party-switch row was the first. Where an observable exists, read it; where none does, act and check what happened. Neither requires being right in advance.
next_failure: Failed to enter Route 11, inside the cave's heal-and-return, after the Vermilion nurse. Instrumented to report where we left the Center, where the return path put us, and the map and x at each step of the walk east.
still_true: Nothing has trained at Diglett's Cave yet. The 29 cave encounters in this run's log are the route's own Diglett capture, as in every previous run.
